1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __tissue that is radially displaced from the path__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __for ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target tissue site__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned between tissue layers before radial expansion__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining the device in that position during radial expansion__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel patent__.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that has been radially displaced__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __for ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target tissue site through the reinforced channel__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the device in that position during radial expansion and reinforcement__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the working channel patent__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __after the medical procedure is completed__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that has been radially displaced__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the working channel patent__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __for ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target tissue site through the stent channel__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the device in that position during sequential radial expansion and contraction__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __after the medical procedure is completed__.
